fallbackAnswer: That question is outside this demo. In this preview I can only answer from a small set of sample entries about the featured projects, the capability map, the experience section and contact status. The live assistant will answer from verified sources once it is connected.

entries.answer: This preview features four project worlds: TIBYN — aquaculture management SaaS focused on aquaculture intelligence; MOViD Studio — a multi-agent video production studio; ATS Matching — AI candidate matching with observability; and LifeAtlas — an AI product concept that is still in development. Detailed case studies are being prepared and will be published after content review.

The capability map groups the stack into four layers. Intelligence: LLMs, agents, RAG, prompting and evaluation. Engineering: Python, FastAPI, Next.js, databases and system design. Operations: Docker, CI/CD, cloud, monitoring and DevOps. Experience: product thinking, UX flow, prototyping and user-centered design. Evidenced examples for each layer will be added after the profile review.

The verified career history hasn't been added yet. The Experience section currently shows a clearly labelled sample journey. Once the CV is supplied and approved, this assistant will answer from it — with citations to the exact source entries.
Direct contact details will be published after the final profile review. Until then, the Contact page lists which channels are ready and which are still pending.
